$comment: Brand settings for Plutto (plutto.space). Edit, then run `npm run build`. Style: Negative Space (approaches/negative-space). Choices and reasons: campaigns/launch/brief.md.
name: Plutto

color.$comment: Palettes by combination number (1-348) from Sanzo Wada's A Dictionary of Color Combinations. primary = 255 in dark mode: Black ground (the site's void), Wada White for type (the site's white text), Pyrite Yellow as the one gold accent (closest Wada gold in a combination with Black; the site's #D4AF37 is not in the Wada palette). Calamine Blue and Raw Sienna stay as support and are kept out of the launch pieces. status stays placeholder until the user approves.

typography.$comment: instrument = Instrument Serif over Instrument Sans (Negative Space rates it core). The site sets Cormorant Garamond (light) over Inter in app/layout.js; its README says Playfair Display. Neither is in pairings.json; Instrument Serif is the closest quiet, high-contrast display serif with an italic. No hand face: Negative Space allows none.
